definitions.explanation: A student who has just entered a school or university.

examples.japanese: {新入生|しんにゅうせい}⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A welcome party for new students was held.

examples.japanese: {新入生|しんにゅうせい}は⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧に⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧をする。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧の{新入生|しんにゅうせい}は500⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だ。
examples.english: There are 500 new students this year.

examples.japanese: {新入生|しんにゅうせい}のオリエンテーションが⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧ある。
examples.english: The new student orientation is next week.

examples.japanese: {新入生|しんにゅうせい}は⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧の一か{月|げつ}は⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧するものだ。
examples.english: New students are typically nervous for the first month.

notes:
{新入生|しんにゅうせい} combines ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧ (new entry) + {生|せい} (student).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{在校生|ざいこうせい}→在校生：17792_zaikousei⟧ (current student)
- ⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧ (graduate)
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧ (senior student)
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧ (junior student)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {新入生|しんにゅうせい}⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧ (freshman welcome party)
- {新入生|しんにゅうせい}オリエンテーション (freshman orientation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新入生|しんにゅうせい}: new student (school context)
- ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: new employee (company context)
- {一|いち}{年生|ねんせい}: first-year student

USAGE:
- Used for students at all levels: elementary through university
- {新入生|しんにゅうせい} is particularly emphasized during April, the start of the Japanese school year
